_guide: // education.json - one card per qualification in the Education section.
// schemaVersion: always 1. It tells the loader which shape to expect; do not change it.
// section: heading text plus on/off switches for search, filters, sorting and detail views.
// REQUIRED per record: id, qualification. Everything else is optional and hidden when empty.
// id: unique and stable, prefix edu- (edu-001). Career Timeline references it.
// institution.name: school or university. Empty hides the institution line.
// institution.website: full https URL; empty hides the link.
// qualification: the award itself, e.g. 'Bachelor of Technology'.
// dates: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. isCurrent true renders 'Present'.
// coursework: list of subjects shown as tags.
// achievements: [{ id, title, description }] optional awards.
// order: manual position. enabled: false hides the record.
// isSample: true marks example content; the section then shows a notice.

section.title: Education
section.subtitle: Academic background. The first record is the published degree; the second shows every optional field filled with sample data.

education.description: Sample record showing a completed qualification with dates, grade and coursework. Replace it with your own school record or delete it.

achievements.title: Sample achievement
achievements.description: Replace with an award, a rank or a subject prize.
